test_title: PYST 22: SSC MTS 2023 - English (Held On: 13 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The teacher assured: “You have completed your homework, __________?”
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the question, the teacher is asking for confirmation, which requires a question tag at the end of the sentence.
 
• The main clause is positive (**you have completed**), so the question tag should be** negative.**
 
• Therefore, the correct question tag is "haven't you".

Hence, the correct statement is **"*The teacher assured: “You have completed your homework, haven't you?__”*.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Question tags are used to seek confirmation and are generally the opposite form of the main clause (**positive main clause has negative question tag and vice versa).**

 
 
• **Example:** *She is coming, **isn't she?***
 
 
 
• If the main clause is negative, the question tag will be positive.
 
 
• **Example:** *He isn't coming, **is he?***
